name: strict mode header
script dir
text: script_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

name: die helper
temp dir with cleanup trap
require a command
text: command -v {cursor} >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "{cursor} is required"

name: function with locals
arg parsing (long flags)
text:
usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: script [options] <input>...

Options:
  -o, --out FILE   Write results to FILE
  -v, --verbose    Print more output
  -h, --help       Show this help
EOF
}

out=""
verbose=false
args=()

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    -o | --out)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "--out needs a value"
      out="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    -v | --verbose)
      verbose=true
      shift
      ;;
    -h | --help)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    --)
      shift
      args+=("$@")
      break
      ;;
    -*)
      usage >&2
      die "unknown option: $1"
      ;;
    *)
      args+=("$1")
      shift
      ;;
  esac
done

set -- "${args[@]+"${args[@]}"}"
[[ $# -gt 0 ]] || { usage >&2; die "at least one input is required"; }

{cursor}

name: arg parsing (getopts, short flags)
usage heredoc
text:
usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: {cursor} [options] <arg>

Options:
  -h, --help   Show this help
EOF
}

name: require positional args
text: [[ $# -ge {cursor} ]] || die "usage: $0 <arg>"

name: loop over positional args
for over list
text:
for item in {cursor}; do
  printf '%s\n' "$item"
done

name: for over array
text:
for item in "${{cursor}[@]}"; do
  printf '%s\n' "$item"
done

name: for over range
text:
for i in {1..{cursor}}; do
  printf '%s\n' "$i"
done

name: for C-style
text:
for ((i = 0; i < {cursor}; i++)); do
  printf '%s\n' "$i"
done

name: for over files (glob)
text:
shopt -s nullglob
for file in {cursor}/*.txt; do
  printf '%s\n' "$file"
done
shopt -u nullglob

name: while read lines from file
text:
while IFS= read -r line; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line"
done < "{cursor}"

name: while read from command
text:
while IFS= read -r line; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line"
done < <({cursor})

name: while read null-delimited (find)
text:
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  printf '%s\n' "$file"
done < <(find {cursor} -type f -print0)

name: while read fields
text:
while IFS=, read -r first second rest; do
  printf '%s -> %s\n' "$first" "$second"
done < "{cursor}"

name: until loop (retry)
text:
until {cursor}; do
  sleep 1
done

name: retry with attempts
text:
attempts=5
for ((i = 1; i <= attempts; i++)); do
  if {cursor}; then
    break
  fi
  [[ $i -lt $attempts ]] || die "failed after $attempts attempts"
  sleep $((i * 2))
done

name: if / elif / else
text:
if [[ {cursor} ]]; then
  :
elif [[ -n "$other" ]]; then
  :
else
  :
fi

name: string tests
text:
[[ -z "${{cursor}:-}" ]] && echo "unset or empty"
[[ -n "${var:-}" ]] && echo "set"
[[ "$a" == "$b" ]] && echo "equal"
[[ "$a" != "$b" ]] && echo "different"
[[ "$name" == pre* ]] && echo "prefix match"

name: numeric tests
text:
if (( {cursor} > 10 )); then
  echo "greater"
elif (( count == 0 )); then
  echo "zero"
fi

name: file tests
text:
[[ -e "{cursor}" ]] || die "missing: $path"
[[ -f "$path" ]] && echo "regular file"
[[ -d "$path" ]] && echo "directory"
[[ -s "$path" ]] && echo "not empty"
[[ -r "$path" ]] && echo "readable"
[[ -x "$path" ]] && echo "executable"

name: case statement
text:
case "${cursor}" in
  start)
    echo "starting"
    ;;
  stop | halt)
    echo "stopping"
    ;;
  *)
    die "usage: $0 {start|stop}"
    ;;
esac

name: regex match
text:
if [[ "{cursor}" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
  major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  minor="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  patch="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
fi

name: default and required values
text:
name="${1:-default}"
: "${{cursor}:?must be set}"

name: short-circuit guard
text: {cursor} || die "failed"

name: array
text:
items=({cursor})
items+=("another")

printf '%s\n' "${items[@]}"
echo "count: ${#items[@]}"
echo "first: ${items[0]}"

name: associative array
text:
# bash 4+; on bash 3.2 (macOS /bin/bash) this silently becomes an indexed array
declare -A {cursor}=([host]=localhost [port]=8080)
config[user]=admin

for key in "${!config[@]}"; do
  printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "${config[$key]}"
done

name: string manipulation
text:
path="{cursor}/report.tar.gz"

echo "${path##*/}"        # report.tar.gz  — basename
echo "${path%/*}"         # leading dirs   — dirname
echo "${path%%.*}"        # strip all extensions
echo "${path//old/new}"   # replace every match
echo "${path^^}"          # upper case (bash 4+)
echo "${#path}"           # length

name: heredoc
text:
cat <<'EOF'
literal text, $no expansion
EOF

cat <<EOF
expanded: ${cursor}
EOF
